items.name: poisson_reconstruction
items.notice: WebSfM ships a changed copy: without threads, and with a patch to the surface level.

groups.group: Code and tables in WebSfM’s own source

items.name: AprilTag
items.use: The tag36h11 codes, for Detect Targets

items.name: OpenCV ArUco dictionaries
items.use: The DICT_4X4, DICT_5X5 and DICT_6X6 codes, for Detect Targets
items.notice: Copyright (C) 2000-2022, Intel Corporation, all rights reserved; and others.

items.name: MicaSense imageprocessing
items.use: The radiometric model for MicaSense multispectral cameras

items.name: SuperPoint
items.use: Not distributed: you supply the weights file yourself

items.name: LightGlue
items.use: The LightGlue matchers, and the ALIKED network code WebSfM exported

items.name: LightGlue-ONNX
items.use: The ONNX exports of DISK and of LightGlue for SuperPoint and DISK

items.name: SAM 2
items.use: Auto mask (sam2-hiera-tiny, as exported to ONNX by onnx-community on Hugging Face)

items.name: PaddleOCR
items.use: Finding and reading text on photos (PP-OCRv5 mobile detector and English recogniser, converted to ONNX by WebSfM), and their character table

items.name: EPSG Geodetic Parameter Dataset
items.use: The coordinate reference systems you can pick (through the epsg-index package)
items.notice: The EPSG Geodetic Parameter Dataset is owned by IOGP (International Association of Oil & Gas Producers).

items.name: EGM96 and EGM2008 geoid models
items.notice: Resampled to a 15′ grid from the U.S. National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency’s EGM96 and EGM2008 models, as PROJ distributes them.

items.name: Aukerman Park photos
items.notice: Thank you to OpenDroneMap for sharing these photos. WebSfM uses 42 of the 77 photos (the flight's second lap), downscaled to 2,400 px.
